summary: This PR enriches two existing v1 GET endpoints (construction/boq and projexa/work-progress/activities) with additive read-only fields (lineItems, categories) needed by the PROJEXA Work Progress Report, plus a new ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml registration entry; verified against the actual service-layer code that getBoq() and listCategories() both correctly scope every query by orgId (no cross-tenant leakage), that the route handlers keep existing auth via requireAuthOrApiKey with no privilege changes, that no schema/migration/workflow files are touched, and that the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml collision-avoidance claim (only touching these two route.ts files, not the schema.ts/service files claimed by the concurrent hierarchical-boq-breakdown task) holds up against the diff. The only soft concern is that the BOQ route now does an N+1 pattern (calling getBoq() per BoQ header, each issuing two more queries) instead of a single batched query, which is a minor efficiency nit rather than a correctness or security defect given typical per-project BoQ revision counts.
issues: Minor: GET /api/v1/construction/boq now does an N+1 query pattern (Promise.all over listBoqs() results each calling getBoq(), which itself issues 2 queries) instead of one batched query with line items joined -- fine at expected scale but worth a follow-up if BoQ revision counts grow large.
